requirements: R1: Remove Playwright mocks to interact with the real backend in E2E tests.
R2: Wire and use the ConsentBanner.svelte component in the frontend instead of inline HTML.
R3: Correct recorded verdicts to use strictly binary APPROVE or REJECT statuses.
R4: Implement missing Moodle SSO integration and resolve API 401 rejection errors for authenticated requests.

slices.title: Frontend Audit Resolutions
slices.jtbd: When implementing frontend fixes for this epic, I want the E2E tests to hit real endpoints and the UI to use proper components, so that the verification pipeline passes seamlessly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the Playwright catalog search test, When executed, Then it does not use page.route to fake success and hits the real backend.
Given the index HTML, When the consent banner is rendered, Then it correctly imports and wires the ConsentBanner.svelte component.

slices.title: Code Guardian Verdict Corrections
slices.jtbd: When resolving process findings for this epic, I want review verdicts to adhere strictly to the role charter, so that the merge process is compliant.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given recorded Code Guardian verdicts, When reviewed, Then any 'block' statuses are removed.
Given new verdicts, When submitted, Then they strictly use 'APPROVE' or 'REJECT'.

slices.title: API Authentication and SSO Implementation
slices.jtbd: When addressing missing backend scope for this epic, I want to implement the missing SSO and auth endpoints, so that the API accepts valid requests.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the API endpoints, When an authenticated client makes a request, Then it receives a 200/201 response instead of a 401.
Given the login flow, When a user authenticates, Then it correctly integrates with Moodle SSO.

slices.title: End-to-End QA Validation
slices.jtbd: When QA coverage is applied for this epic, I want to verify that the integrated changes across all layers work end-to-end, so that the deployed application actually meets the brief's objectives.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the deployed test environment, When the full user journey from Moodle login to catalog search is executed, Then the system seamlessly authenticates and returns actual data without mocking.
Given the backend API, When integration tests run against the updated SSO endpoints, Then they pass successfully without 401 regressions.
Given the frontend layer, When the consent banner and search components are rendered, Then they pass accessibility and structural UI tests.
